items.title: 📢 SALT Centre Level 3 Gym Closure Notice on 27 July (Monday)
items.author: Lek Jian Rong
items.description:
Dear students,
Please note that the SALT Centre Level 3 Gym will be closed on Monday, 27 July, from 2:00 PM to 4:30 PM, due to a Knee Injury Prevention Workshop being conducted in the gym.
The gym will resume normal operations on Tuesday, 28 July, from 2:00 PM to 4:30 PM.
We apologise for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
Regards,
SALT Department

items.title: [NE Reps] [SNECxVIAC collaboration] Re: All classes supporting Toy Buffet 2026
items.author: Cai Yi Tian
items.description:
Hey Hwa Chong! 👋
In the spirit of this year's National Day theme, "Majulah Singapura, Go Beyond!", the 14th Students' National Education Council and Values-in-Action Council are organising a Toy Donation Drive (in support for Food From The Heart’s annual Toy Buffet) to bring joy to children in need — because going beyond our usual connections means showing kindness and strengthening our community as we celebrate Singapore's 61st birthday. (Interested to read about past iterations of Toy Buffet? See
https://www.foodfromtheheart.sg/highlights/toy-buffet-2025-245)
For a class of 25 students, do divide into 5 groups of 5 students, with each group preparing one toy for a child aged 5–12 years old. This is a chance to practise empathy and generosity as a team. Before the timetabled CT period in T3W6/W7, groups should discuss and agree on a suitable toy to buy and why, then decide on one member to make the purchase, with the rest reimbursing them. During CT period, each group will write an encouraging message to accompany their gift and wrap it with care. Please read the details attached below for how to make this toy collection a meaningful success!
Warmest regards,
SNEC & VIAC ❤️
__________________________________________________________________________
Toy Guidelines
🎁
No soft toys allowed due to hygiene and allergen considerations.
Brand-new toys are preferred, but preloved toys are also welcomed, provided they are clean, in GREAT condition, and come with complete packaging.
Toys should be meaningful and fall under one of the following categories:
1. Board Games
2. Games Set
3. Educational
4. Building
5. Creative Making
6. Sports
7. Dolls/Robots
8. Electronic
Please see the attached image for details.
Wrapping & Message Writing
📝
During the Term 3 Week 6 / 7 class CT period, classes will wrap the 5 toys they have prepared beforehand and write 5 heartfelt messages (one for each toy) into the 5 cards collected by your NE Reps. Please let your
CT vet and approve the messages
before inserting the cards into the wrapped presents
.
You may wish to refer to the examples below:
"We hope you will enjoy and like this toy as much as we did because it brought us so many unforgettable game nights full of laughter and friendly competition. May it bring your favourite people together for endless fun, strategic thinking, and clever moves!"
"We hope you will enjoy and like this toy as much as we did because it gave us so many different ways to play, challenge each other, and share big smiles. May it keep your days exciting and turn every afternoon into a brand-new adventure!"
'We hope you will enjoy and like this toy as much as we did because it let us bring our wildest imaginations to life, piece by piece. May it inspire you to dream big, test your ideas, and build incredible creations you are proud of!"
1. Transparent wrapping materials (55 x 55 cm) and cards will be provided to each class.
2. NE Reps are to collect these
materials at the SNIAC Room between
0740hrs and 0800hrs
on the day allocated in the collection schedule below.
3. Classes are reminded to bring their own clear tape, scissors and colouring stationery to decorate the cards.
Collection Details (for the toys that are wrapped)
Date 📅: 3 – 21 August 2026
Time ⏰: 1500-1700h
Venue📍: SNIAC Room (next to Printing Shop)
NE and CT reps are to bring the wrapped toys and completed messages to the SNIAC Room during the above time period on the day allocated in the collection schedule below
Classes are to keep the toys with them until the end of the day, and are reminded not to leave the toys in the classroom
